turns.text: Hey Lloyd, do you remember if we already handled the expense reports for last week's conference?
I believe we started the process, but I don't have a record of the final submission status in my current view.
Right. Well, I just paid Jim back. PayPal was used to reimburse Jim for the exhibitor lunches.
Understood. I've noted that Jim was reimbursed via PayPal for those specific meals.
Also, did my order for the new mechanical keyboard ship yet? The tracking hasn't updated in two days.
Let me check the carrier status... It looks like it is currently in transit and expected to arrive on Tuesday.
Great, thanks. And what's the weather looking like for the weekend? I'm hoping to go hiking.
It looks promising! Mostly sunny with highs around 75 degrees, so perfect for a hike.
Awesome. I'll pack accordingly. Thanks Lloyd.
